additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432794-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004100] CableTemp sensor error on both outlets CRM:02919000004
additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel Kaiblinger,
Hope you're doing well.
As You mentioned issues related to the cable temperature sensors, which seem to clear after a reboot. From our side, the charger currently appears healthy, with no active error flags.
Regarding the firmware update — I understand you're unable to proceed as it's showing "rollout initiated."
To move forward, we recommend upgrading the charger firmware to version 6.0. This update includes improved logging capabilities, which will help us better analyze and monitor any recurring issues. Once the upgrade is complete, we can continue to monitor the charger and investigate further if the error reappears.
Please let us know if we can proceed with the upgrade.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432794-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004100] CableTemp sensor error on both outlets CRM:02919000004
additional_info.body:
Hi Vikas,
So, I did a reboot today in the morning, but the Error occurs again. Now I can see that someone is currently charging at the station... Strange^^
Did you reboot the charger? Do you know what (VIV:0 SOV:1 CFeed:1) means?
Yes, please update the Charger, but wait till no one is charging. Our customer wants to know the reason for this Error. Beside the Charger is another one without the error.
If you need me onsite for charging tests or whatever, please talk to me as soon as possible. I can go there tomorrow.
BR
Daniel

additional_info.subject: RE: 0432794 - ID0432794-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004100] CableTemp sensor error on both outlets CRM:00472000321

Hi Joao,
after we finally got the key, I was at the Charger in Großweikersdorf yesterday.
As expected, there is still enough coolant left. I checked the charger and discovered a possible loose contact. when I open the terminal, the error occurs as usual. Can you please continue to monitor the charger. if the cabletemp error no longer occurs this week, we can assume that this was the error.
Thank you
Best regards
Daniel
